nodes.title: What happens when you try to sign in?
answers: It says my password is wrong
I don't get the verification code

nodes.title: Reset your password
nodes.text: Click "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter your account email. The reset link is valid for 1 hour. Check spam if it does not arrive within 5 minutes.

nodes.title: Are you sure you are using the email you signed up with?
Try your other email addresses
nodes.text: Many people sign up with a work or old personal email. Try a password reset for each address; only the right one will receive an email.

nodes.title: Is Caps Lock off and the keyboard language correct?
You are in
nodes.text: Tip: a password manager fills in passwords exactly, so typing mistakes do not lock you out.

nodes.title: Reset your password
nodes.text: If you are sure of the email and the typing, the fastest fix is a password reset.

nodes.title: Check spam and wait 2 minutes
nodes.text: Codes can take a couple of minutes. Check spam and promotions folders, and only use the newest code if you requested more than one.

nodes.title: Check your phone signal
nodes.text: Make sure the phone has signal and can receive texts from short codes. Wait 2 minutes before requesting a new code.

nodes.title: Check the time on your phone
nodes.text: Authenticator codes depend on the clock. Turn on automatic date and time on your phone, then try the newest code. If you lost the phone, use a backup code or contact support.

nodes.title: Wait 15 minutes or contact support
nodes.text: Accounts lock for 15 minutes after several failed attempts. Wait and try again, or contact support to verify your identity.
